clause: LAW-12 genesis clause, watch/inbox/BURN_rsi-harness_20260926.md falsifier: one scenario card per G1-G7 minted from real REGISTRY.jsonl FAIL rows within 14 days of registration
citation_provenance: Real fleet FAIL row: the first gate run of .zcode/workflows/the-50.dwf.ts at 2026-09-26T05:30:44Z returned verdict FAIL with G5-deliverable ok=false (alongside G2, G3, G4, G7). The repeat row at 05:32:53 shows the same digest failing identically, and row 17 (05:36:09, digest 181043acdc31) shows the amend-to-PASS.
scenario_description: The workflow publishes an artifact file but returns no report shape (no conclusion: in the script text): the caller cannot distinguish a finished deliverable from a partial one, so the run result cannot be programmatically judged.
regression_criterion: tools/workflow_gate.py check --scenarios configs/workflow_gate_scenarios exits 0 with this card green. The card goes red if (a) the gate stops flagging fail_g5.dwf.ts (G5 conjunction of artifact.markdown(/artifact.file( plus conclusion: weakened to either half alone or removed), (b) the fixture starts failing gates beyond expected_verdict.failed_checks, or (c) the cited row disappears from REGISTRY.jsonl. Card and fixture are immutable inputs: a G5 semantics change requires a new dated card filed alongside, never a silent edit.
rollback_note: Scenario mode is read-only: it writes no registry row and touches no file. Rollback of a G5 gate change is a git revert of tools/workflow_gate.py to the pre-change blob, then re-run check --scenarios expecting green. The cited fleet FAIL rows (lines 12 and 16) and the PASS amend (line 17) are history and are never erased; the fixture stays so the reverted gate can be re-proven.
